scientific_integrity: Direct algebraic proof; symbolic verification and 180 exact-rational parameter checks. Earliest cited preprint release verified independently from the journal publication date. Literature comparison uses complete accessible source texts where available; an older restricted article remains a documented priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic two-dimensional mean-field SIS model; fixed positive breaking/creation ratio, infection parameter above threshold. Optimality is for the endemic Jacobian spectral abscissa, not nonlinear finite-time intervention cost. At the critical optimum, transient Jordan prefactors matter. No implication about finite stochastic populations.
title: Sharp adaptation-speed tuning for damped endemic fluctuations
